Name: Exploitation Usability
Description: The Exploitation Usability extension is intended to allow a user program to determine if the image is usable for the exploitation problem currently being performed. It also contains some catalogue metadata. The format and descriptions for the user-defined fields of the USE00A are detailed in table 7.4.

ANGLE_TO_NORTH.Name: Angle to North
ANGLE_TO_NORTH.Description: This field represents the angle to true north measured clockwise from the first row of the image.

MEAN_GSD.Name: Mean Ground Sample Distance
MEAN_GSD.Description: This field represents the geometric mean of the cross and along scan center-to-center distance between contiguous ground samples. The accuracy = plus or minus 10%.  NOTE: Systems requiring an extended range shall insert a default value of "000.0" for this field and utilize the PIAMC tag.

DYNAMIC_RANGE.Name: Dynamic Range
DYNAMIC_RANGE.Description: This field represents the dynamic range of the pixels in the image.

OBL_ANG.Name: Obliquity Angle
OBL_ANG.Description: This field represents the obliquity angle of the image collection.

ROLL_ANG.Name: Roll Angle
ROLL_ANG.Description: This field represents the roll angle of the image collection.

N_REF.Name: Number of Reference Lines
N_REF.Description: This field represents the number of reference lines in the image. For each reference line, there will be a REFLNA extension in the NITF file.

REV_NUM.Name: Revolution Number
REV_NUM.Description: This field represents the revolution number in effect at the northernmost point of orbit.

N_SEG.Name: Number of Segments
N_SEG.Description: This field represents the number of image segments.

MAX_LP_SEG.Name: Maximum Lines Per Segment
MAX_LP_SEG.Description: This field represents the maximum number of lines per segment, including overlap lines. The maximum number of lines per segment depends upon the aggregation mode of the collector.

SUN_EL.Name: Sun Elevation
SUN_EL.Description: This field represents degrees measured from the target plane at intersection of the optical line of sight with the earth's surface at the time of the first image line.  The default value, if data is not available, is 999.9.

SUN_AZ.Name: Sun Azimuth
SUN_AZ.Description: This field represents degrees measured from true North clockwise (as viewed from space) at the time of the first image line. The default value, if data is not available, is 999.9.
